findings.claim: A locally oscillatory height model improves the 200 ms forecast over native persistence on a new complete release.
findings.equation: hhat=h+v sin(omega H)/omega+a[1-cos(omega H)]/omega², H=0.2 s.
findings.evidence: Selected development MAE 13.223 mm; reserved MAE 12.228 mm versus persistence 11.667 mm and flexible 13.688 mm.
findings.known_prior_art: Local harmonic propagation is an established kinematic approximation.
findings.falsification: Its modest development advantage over persistence does not survive the reserved event.
findings.scope: One station, one reserved controlled release, causal 220 ms history.

findings.claim: Unattenuated local slope extrapolation is a poor transferable 200 ms surface-height predictor in these experiments.
findings.evidence: Development MAE 28.956 versus 13.718 mm; confirmation 23.193 versus 11.667 mm.
findings.known_prior_art: Noisy surface measurements and evolving fronts need not follow constant local velocity.
findings.falsification: This is not a test of bulk flow velocity or a proof of a particular turbulence mechanism.
findings.scope: Fixed issuance grid, original signed laser signal, all eligible observations.

findings.claim: Depth-dependent memory, front/recession asymmetry and median observation filtering do not establish a stronger selected predictive law.
findings.evidence: All three fail to improve the best development structure; all saved confirmation comparisons remain available.
findings.known_prior_art: Dissipation, gravity-wave scaling and robust filtering are established families.
findings.falsification: The short history and five runs cannot identify a unique governing flow mechanism.
findings.scope: Sensor nowcasting only; not field early-warning performance.

scientific_adjudication: Agent-assisted analysis; not independent experimental replication or human expert adjudication.
